GTP::payload
Description
Returns the payload, either complete or partial, for G-PDU message.
This command returns an empty value, in case of non-G-PDU messages.
Syntax
GTP
::
payload
GTP
::
payload
[
<
offset
>
]
<
length
>
GTP::payload
* Returns the entire payload for G-PDU message. This command returns
an empty value, in case of non-G-PDU messages.
GTP::payload ` <%3Coffset%3E.html>`__
* Returns bytes from given of G-PDU’s payload. Absence of offset is
considered as offset = 0.
